english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who willingly follows orders or instructions.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person who willingly does what they are told.
Use this especially for a child who obeys instructions and does what they are expected to do.

examples.english: The boss tells me to follow the procedure, and I am always obedient.
examples.traditional: 老闆叫我跟程序做，我一向都好聽話。
examples.jyutping: lou5 baan2 giu3 ngo5 gan1 cing4 zeoi6 zou6 ngo5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 teng1 waa6

examples.english: My son was very compliant today; when I told him to put away his toys, he did it right away.
examples.traditional: 個仔今日好聽話，叫佢收玩具就即刻收。
examples.jyutping: go3 zai2 gam1 jat6 hou2 teng1 waa6 giu3 keoi5 sau1 wun6 geoi6 zau6 zik1 hak1 sau1

examples.english: The boy is very dutiful and takes his medicine as soon as we ask.
examples.traditional: 個仔好聽話，叫佢食藥就即刻食。
examples.jyutping: go3 zai2 hou2 teng1 waa6 giu3 keoi5 sik6 joek6 zau6 zik1 hak1 sik6
